claims.claim: Anthropic dated the Opus 5.5 announcement September 22, 2026.
Anthropic says Opus 5.5 is available on all platforms, including AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and its Claude Platform under model ID claude-opus-5-5.
The published API prices are $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens; fast mode is $8 and $40 respectively.
claims.requiredQualifier: These are token/API prices, not monthly Claude subscription prices.

claims.claim: Anthropic says it increased five-hour usage limits on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans and added a saveable rate-limit reset for subscription users.
claims.requiredQualifier: The announcement does not quantify the limits or establish identical access for every plan.

claims.claim: A reader on any named paid plan can necessarily select Opus 5.5 in ordinary Claude chat today.
Opus 5.5 is faster, safer, more capable, or cheaper per completed task than competing models for a typical reader.
claims.requiredQualifier: Any use must be attributed to Anthropic and retain the evaluation conditions; a reader-specific conclusion is unsupported.
